content: An oral irrigator, also known as a water pick, is a device designed to remove food debris from the teeth by utilizing a pulsating jet of water. This tool is particularly beneficial for individuals with braces, as it serves as an alternative to traditional dental floss. It is also commonly used by patients with periodontal issues or as a preventive measure to maintain periodontal health by cleaning the gingival sulcus. Certain oral irrigators, such as the HydroFloss and Oxycare 3000, incorporate water ionization technology, which is claimed to enhance cleaning efficacy. These devices are sometimes referred to as hydromagnetic irrigators due to their use of magnetic fields in the ionization process. Popular brands of oral irrigators include Waterpik and HydroFloss. In addition to its primary use, an oral irrigator can also be employed to remove tonsil stones in patients suffering from tonsillitis.
